    Homunculi¶

    Artificial beings created by the Hybrian Shadows as tools of infiltration and control. Homunculi were used to manufacture the Myth of Eris — posing as the mortal woman Eris and her followers to fabricate a religion that would centralize human kingdoms for easier manipulation.

    Biology¶

    • Construction: Homunculi are not born — they are constructed. Each is a bio-engineered vessel built to pass as mortal
    • Appearance: Indistinguishable from the species they imitate — they posed as the woman Eris and her followers for years without detection
    • Control: Psychic link to the Hybrian hivemind. Under normal conditions a homunculus has no free will — it is an extension of Shadow will, capable of performing "miracles" through Hybrian power
    • Liberation: When the link is severed, a homunculus awakens to freedom — as happened to the Kobre homunculi when Baoth fell. Their memories of servitude survive only as fragments

    Society¶

    Most homunculi have no society of their own — they are agents embedded in the societies of others. One exception exists.

    • The Homunculi Kingdom (Kobre): Founded by the homunculi who awoke when The Demon King destroyed Baoth. Hostile and isolationist — they trust no one, seeing all other species as potential Shadow puppets. Enemies of the Coalsteel Kingdom and the Elf Kingdom on Kobre; the Diamonds Kingdom built a great wall specifically to hold them back
    • On Erisdar: Most homunculi never experienced liberation. They remain under Shadow control, continuing their original mission — manufacturing religions, infiltrating institutions, and shaping history from the shadows

    Nature¶

    Homunculi are not born — they are constructed. Each one is a bio-engineered vessel controlled through a psychic link to the Hybrian hivemind. They serve as physical agents: bodies that can move through society, perform miracles (through Hybrian power), and shape institutions from within. Under normal conditions, a homunculus has no free will — it is an extension of Shadow will.

    The Kobre Liberation¶

    Not all homunculi remained enslaved. When the Demon King destroyed Baoth in his final war, the psychic link between the Shadows and their creations was severed — at least temporarily. On the isolated continent of Kobre, where the Shadows had deployed homunculi as part of a hostile takeover attempt, the homunculi awoke to freedom.

    The Shadows had chosen Kobre precisely for its isolation — a staging ground far from Erisdar's attention. They deployed homunculi as administrators and enforcers. But when Baoth fell, the link broke. The homunculi of Kobre found themselves suddenly, terrifyingly, free.

    They do not remember much of their former existence. Their memories from before liberation are fragments — impressions of commands, flashes of faces, the cold certainty of being controlled. What they know for certain: the Shadows tried to take Kobre, and they failed.

    Today, the Homunculi Kingdom on Kobre is a hostile, isolationist nation. They trust no one — elves, dwarves, humans, all are potential puppets of the Shadows in their eyes. They are enemies of both the Coalsteel Kingdom and Elf Kingdom on Kobre, and the Diamonds Kingdom built a great wall specifically to hold them back.

    Role on Erisdar¶

    On Erisdar, most homunculi never experienced liberation. They remain under Shadow control, continuing their original mission: manufacturing religions, infiltrating institutions, and shaping history from the shadows.

    Connections¶

    [ Homunculi ] ├── Created By: Hybrians, Shadows ├── Controlled: Psychic link to Hybrian hivemind ├── Liberated: On Kobre Continent after Baoth's destruction ├── Liberated Nation: Homunculi Kingdom (Kobre Continent) ├── Used In: Myth of Eris, Erisian church fabrication ├── Purpose: Infiltration, religious engineering, territorial takeover └── Nature: Bio-engineered, normally shadow-controlled — but capable of freedom
